6835.title: Synchronous event persistence blocks timers during SQLite waits
6835.rootCauseOneLine: Synchronous daemon-event transactions wait on SQLite in the server thread; cold-read attribution remains unverified.
6835.proposedFix: Design asynchronous database ownership; preserve existing covering index and bounded pruning. No safe simple fix.
6835.caveats: Controlled 700 ms write-lock experiment, not the reported cold-read I/O incident; no macOS or large-database outage reproduced.
